title: **Haji-Sadeghi Tours Southern Missile Tunnels**
text:
**Haji-Sadeghi Tours Southern Missile Tunnels**"

"Hojjat al-Islam Haji-Sadeghi, the Supreme Leader’s representative in the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), visited IRGC Navy missile tunnels during a trip to southern Iran."

"The visit shifted the trip from meetings with families of martyrs (fallen soldiers) to the heart of operational capability: tunnels described as part of a strategy to protect and maintain military capacity in a state of readiness, drawing on coastal geography, anti-ship missiles, and fast attack craft."

"📍 Excerpt from *In the Fortress of Faith*, a special program by the IRGC television team."
